profiles.description: Network profiles the rule applies in: "domain", "private", "public". Unset means all.

protocol.description: "tcp", "udp", "icmpv4", "icmpv6" or "any" (default). An inbound allow rule with no local_ports and no remote_addresses must set it, so a rule that lets everything in is never made by leaving settings out.

remote_addresses.description: Addresses the traffic comes from or goes to: IP addresses, subnets such as 10.0.0.0/8, ranges such as 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.9, or LocalSubnet. Unset means any.

windows_group.description: A local group on a Windows host, and who is in it. Settings left unset are left as they are.

authoritative.description: true makes members the complete list: anyone else is taken out. Never the login Conn3x uses.

members.description: Users and groups that must be in it, by name, such as LAB\alice, or by SID. Others are left in unless authoritative is set.

name.description: Group name, such as Remote Desktop Users.

on_remove.description: What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the group, "delete" deletes it.

windows_iis_app_pool.description: An IIS application pool, found by its name.

identity.description: Account the pool runs as: "ApplicationPoolIdentity" (default), "NetworkService", "LocalService" or "LocalSystem".

name.description: The pool's name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) -.

on_remove.description: "delete" (default) deletes the pool when the step is removed or replaced, "forget" leaves it.

state.description: "started" (default) or "stopped". Also whether it starts with IIS.

windows_iis_site.description: An IIS site, found by its name.

app_pool.description: Application pool the site runs in, which must exist. A new site gets IIS's default; an existing one keeps its own when unset.

name.description: The site's name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) -.

on_remove.description: "delete" (default) deletes the site when the step is removed or replaced, "forget" leaves it. Its files stay either way.

physical_path.description: Folder the site serves, on a local drive, such as C:\sites\www.

state.description: "started" (default) or "stopped". Also whether it starts with IIS.

binding.description: Where the site listens. These are all its bindings: one added by hand shows as drift and is removed.

host_header.description: Host name the site answers to, such as www.example.com. Unset answers any.

ip.description: Address to listen on, or "*" (default) for all.

windows_package.description: An MSI package on a Windows host, found by its product code. It never reboots: reboot_required says whether Windows wants one, and windows_reboot with only_if_pending does it.

allow_http.description: Let url be, or redirect to, plain http. sha256 still has to match. Off by default.

max_size_mb.description: Largest download, in MiB. Defaults to 2048.

product_code.description: The MSI's ProductCode, a GUID in braces. Windows lists the package under it once installed.

properties.description: Public MSI properties, such as INSTALLDIR. They're on msiexec's command line and in state: never secrets.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .msi. Required with source or url: nothing installs unless the file matches.

source.description: Path of the .msi already on the host. Set this or url.

state.description: "present" (default) or "absent".

timeout.description: How long to allow. Defaults to "30m".

url.description: http or https address the host downloads the .msi from. Set this or source.

windows_path.description: Experimental. One folder in a Windows host's Path, the machine's or the login user's. The other folders and their order stay as they are. New logons see a change; programs already running keep the Path they started with.

element.description: The folder, such as C:\Program Files\Go\bin. Compared as Windows does, without case and with or without a trailing backslash. Added at the end.

on_remove.description: What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the folder in Path, "delete" takes it out.

scope.description: "machine" (default), in HKLM for every account, or "user", in HKCU for the account Conn3x logs in as. Changing it is a different Path entry.

state.description: "present" (default), or "absent" to take every copy of the folder out.

windows_powershell.description: A PowerShell script on a Windows host, for what no module covers yet. Guards say when it has already done its job.

args.description: Values the script reads as $A.name. They reach it as data, never as code.

args_wo.description: Like args, but kept out of state: state records only args_hmac, and the values are blanked from output and errors. Use it for secrets.

creates.description: Skip the script while this path exists.

removes.description: Skip the script while this path is missing.

script.description: PowerShell script. Start it with param($A), and read arguments as $A.name rather than interpolating them into the text.

timeout.description: How long the script may run before it is stopped. Defaults to "30m".

triggers.description: Any value; the script runs again whenever it changes.

unless.description: Skip the script while this PowerShell check holds: it holds unless it throws, its last output is $false, or a native program it ran last exited non-zero. It runs at every plan, so it must change nothing. It gets args but never args_wo, which a plan doesn't have.

windows_reboot.description: Reboots a Windows host when created and whenever triggers change, then waits for it to come back. With only_if_pending it reboots only when Windows is waiting for one. Removing it does nothing.

earlier_revisions.description: Set by the circuit, so leave it unset: the revisions of the steps before this one. With only_if_pending, a plan that changes any of them checks for a pending reboot at apply time, so a reboot an earlier step leaves pending comes in the same apply.

only_if_pending.description: Reboot only when Windows reports a reboot is pending, and plan one whenever a refresh finds that, so a reboot a failed run missed still happens.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the host to come back. Defaults to "10m".

triggers.description: Reboot again whenever any of these values change.

windows_registry_value.description: One registry value under HKLM on a Windows host. The value's type and data are compared with what's there, without expanding environment names.

data.description: The data: a decimal number for dword and qword, hex for binary, one value per line for multi_string. Set this or data_wo.

data_wo.description: Like data, but kept out of state: state records only data_hmac. Use it for secrets.

key.description: Key under HKLM, such as HKLM\SOFTWARE\App. Created if it's missing.

name.description: Value name. Leave unset for the key's default value.

on_remove.description: What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the value, "delete" removes the value and leaves the key.

windows_scheduled_task.description: A scheduled task on a Windows host that runs one program.

allow_interpreter.description: Let execute be a program that runs code from its arguments, such as cmd.exe, powershell.exe, wscript.exe, rundll32.exe or python.exe. Conn3x checks the paths it can see in arguments, but not code inside them, such as -Command text or -EncodedCommand.

arguments.description: Its arguments. They're in the task, readable by administrators, and in state: never secrets.

data_paths.description: Full paths in arguments that the program only reads data from or writes output to, such as a log file. Each must appear exactly once in arguments, and skips the admin-only check, so anyone who can write there can change them. Never list a file or folder the program loads code or settings from, or runs.

description.description: Description. Left as it is when unset.

enabled.description: Whether the task can run. Defaults to true.

execute.description: Absolute path of the program to run, such as C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe.

name.description: Task name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) -.

on_remove.description: "delete" (default) deletes the task when the step is removed or replaced, "forget" leaves it.

password_wo.description: The user's password, for a task that needs network access. Kept out of plan and state: state records only password_hmac. A password changed on the host isn't detected.

path.description: Task folder, such as \Conn3x\. Defaults to \. Made if it's missing.

user.description: Account it runs as: SYSTEM, LOCAL SERVICE or NETWORK SERVICE with no password; another account with password_wo; or the login Conn3x uses, without one, to run unattended with no network access (S4U).

trigger.description: When it runs. With none, it runs only when started.

at.description: For daily and once: local time on the host, such as 2026-01-01T03:00:00.

days_interval.description: For daily: every this many days. Defaults to 1.

windows_service.description: A service that already exists on a Windows host: how it starts and whether it's running. Removing the step leaves it as it is.

name.description: Service name, not its display name, such as W3SVC.

start_mode.description: "auto", "delayed", "manual" or "disabled". Left as it is when unset.

state.description: "running" or "stopped". Left as it is when unset.

windows_share.description: Experimental. An SMB share on a Windows host, and who may use it. Access changes in place, never by recreating the share. Deny entries are left alone.

change_access.description: Accounts with Change access, such as BUILTIN\Administrators or CONTOSO\Finance. When any of full_access, change_access and read_access is set, the three together are the share's whole set of Allow entries: others are revoked. Unset, all three, leaves access alone.

description.description: Its description. Unset leaves it alone.

full_access.description: Accounts with Full access, such as BUILTIN\Administrators or CONTOSO\Finance. When any of full_access, change_access and read_access is set, the three together are the share's whole set of Allow entries: others are revoked. Unset, all three, leaves access alone.

name.description: The share name, such as Finance, or Backup$ for one hidden from browsing. Not C$, ADMIN$ or IPC$.

on_remove.description: "delete" (default) removes the share when the step goes, and leaves the folder and its files; "forget" leaves the share.

path.description: The folder it shares, such as D:\Shares\Finance. It must exist; make it with a windows_directory step. A share's folder can't change in place.

read_access.description: Accounts with Read access, such as BUILTIN\Administrators or CONTOSO\Finance. When any of full_access, change_access and read_access is set, the three together are the share's whole set of Allow entries: others are revoked. Unset, all three, leaves access alone.

windows_update.description: The Windows updates a host should have installed, such as this month's security updates. It never reboots: reboot_required says whether Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it.

accept_list.description: Only these KB numbers, such as KB5034441, from those categories.

categories.description: Windows Update categories to install, such as SecurityUpdates and CriticalUpdates (the default). Also: Applications, Connectors, DefinitionUpdates, DeveloperKits, Drivers, FeaturePacks, Guidance, ServicePacks, Tools, UpdateRollups, Updates, Upgrades.

timeout.description: How long downloading and installing may take. Defaults to "2h".

windows_user.description: A local user on a Windows host. Settings left unset are left as they are.

disabled.description: true disables the account, false enables it.

name.description: User name, up to 20 characters.

on_remove.description: What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the user, "delete" deletes it and leaves its profile folder.

password_wo.description: Password, kept out of plan and state: state records only password_hmac. It's set when the user is made and whenever this value changes. A password changed on the host isn't detected.

windows_wait_for.description: Waits until a path exists, a service is running or a TCP port is listening on a Windows host. Refresh checks again, so a later apply waits again if it stopped.

path.description: Path to wait for, such as C:\app\ready. Set exactly one of path, service and port.

port.description: TCP port to wait for a listener on. Set exactly one of path, service and port.

service.description: Name of a service to wait for until it is running. Set exactly one of path, service and port.

timeout.description: How long to wait. Defaults to "5m".

xml_value.description: One element's text or one attribute in an XML file, which should or should not be there. The rest of the file stays as it was, byte for byte.

create.description: Create the file when it is missing. Otherwise a missing file is an error.

group.description: The file's group, set with the edit. Unset keeps the group the file has.

mode.description: The file's mode, such as "0644", set with the edit. Unset keeps the mode the file has, or 0644 for a file it creates.

on_remove.description: "forget" (default) leaves the file as it is, "delete" takes the edit back out.

owner.description: The file's owner, set with the edit. Unset keeps the owner the file has.

path.description: Absolute path of the file.

state.description: "present" (default) or "absent", which takes the attribute or the element out.

validate.description: A command that checks the edited file before it replaces the old one, such as "sshd -t -f %s". %s stands for the temporary file. Runs only when the edit changes the file, and is kept out of state.

value.description: The element's text or the attribute's value, unescaped. Required unless state is "absent".

xpath.description: Which element or attribute, from the root: element names with [@attr='value'] or [n] to pick one, ending in /@name for an attribute, such as /Server/Service/Connector[@port='8080']/@protocol. A missing last element is added.
